strings.notes: Partner-walk comments (Platinum pair_scr, reworked by the hack): 小绿 Blue, 小黄 Yellow, 彦 Riley, 舞 Mira, 小霞 Misty; 滕岩 Byron, 瓢太 Roark, 美央市 Canalave City.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『要是有精灵的话{NEWLINE}我要想办法抓到,{CLEAR}成为精灵训练家！{SCROLL}你知道吧？精灵训练家{NEWLINE}让精灵对决的！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: If I find a Pokémon,{NEWLINE}I’ll catch it somehow and{CLEAR}become a Pokémon Trainer!{SCROLL}You know what a Pokémon Trainer is,{NEWLINE}right? They make Pokémon battle!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『精灵{NEWLINE}有很多种技能呢！{SCROLL}精灵训练家能够命令精灵{NEWLINE}使用何种技能{CLEAR}去进行战斗,太帅了。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Pokémon{NEWLINE}know all kinds of moves!{SCROLL}Pokémon Trainers tell their Pokémon{NEWLINE}which moves to use{CLEAR}in battle. How cool is that?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我也{NEWLINE}好想早点拥有精灵啊。{SCROLL}那样就可以和精灵一起{NEWLINE}周游世界了啊。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I really want my own{NEWLINE}Pokémon soon, too.{SCROLL}Then I could travel the world{NEWLINE}with Pokémon.
strings.notes: | RV058: omission: 我也 (too), 周游世界 (the world)

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『那个湖里{NEWLINE}一定有梦幻的精灵。{SCROLL}虽然大家都说湖里什么都没有,{NEWLINE}但是我相信。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: There’s definitely{NEWLINE}a Mythical Pokémon in that lake.{SCROLL}Everyone says there’s nothing there,{NEWLINE}but I believe it.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我绝对会{NEWLINE}成为精灵训练师的！{SCROLL}而且还是最强的{NEWLINE}精灵训练师！{CLEAR}因为这是我的梦想啊。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I’m totally going{NEWLINE}to be a Pokémon Trainer!{SCROLL}And not just any Trainer:{NEWLINE}the strongest one there is!{CLEAR}Because that’s my dream.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『别只听我说啊。{NEWLINE}咱们到湖边去吧,{SCROLL}我心里都痒痒得{NEWLINE}坐不住了！！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Don’t just listen to me talk.{NEWLINE}Let’s go to the lake!{SCROLL}I’m so excited,{NEWLINE}I can’t sit still!!
strings.notes: | RV058: meaning: 别只听我说 = don't just listen to me

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『好！{NEWLINE}赶紧出发！！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: All right!{NEWLINE}Let’s get going!!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『刚才我也是{NEWLINE}迫不得已才使用了别人的精灵。{SCROLL}可毕竟是人家的精灵啊⋯⋯{NEWLINE}等会还要还给人家。{SCROLL}虽然是第一次一起战斗的{NEWLINE}精灵呢⋯⋯
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Back there, I had no choice{NEWLINE}but to use someone else’s Pokémon too.{SCROLL}But it’s someone else’s Pokémon...{NEWLINE}I’ll have to give it back later.{SCROLL}Even though it’s the first Pokémon{NEWLINE}I ever battled with...
strings.notes: | RV058: meaning: zh speaker says 'I too', singular

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我想{NEWLINE}和它一起变强。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I want to get{NEWLINE}stronger together with it.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『别说那么多了。{NEWLINE}我们还是快走吧⋯⋯{SCROLL}不过你有没有觉得{NEWLINE}现在的速度比刚才慢了？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Enough talking.{NEWLINE}Let’s hurry up...{SCROLL}Hey, don’t you think we’re walking{NEWLINE}slower than before?

strings.zh: 小绿『等一下,{NEWLINE}{VAR:0103:0}！{CLEAR}你在这用穿洞绳穿洞绳,{CLEAR}是想就此退出吗？
strings.en: Blue: Hold on,{NEWLINE}{VAR:0103:0}!{CLEAR}You’re using an Escape Rope here?{CLEAR}You’re just going to bail on me?

strings.zh: 小绿『等一下！{NEWLINE}{VAR:0103:0}！{CLEAR}你在这用瞬间移动,{CLEAR}是想就此退出吗？
strings.en: Blue: Hold on!{NEWLINE}{VAR:0103:0}!{CLEAR}You’re using Teleport here?{CLEAR}You’re just going to bail on me?

strings.zh: 小绿『传说这里有个鬼屋。{NEWLINE}虽然我是不害怕啦,{CLEAR}但还是先走吧⋯⋯
strings.en: Blue: They say there’s a haunted{NEWLINE}house around here. Not that I’m{CLEAR}scared, but let’s keep moving...

strings.zh: 小绿『野生的精灵{NEWLINE}竟然同时跳出来２只！
strings.en: Blue: Two wild Pokémon{NEWLINE}jumped out at the same time!

strings.zh: 小绿『我的精灵{NEWLINE}非常的全面,{CLEAR}绝不局限于哪一种属性。
strings.en: Blue: My Pokémon are{NEWLINE}well-rounded.{CLEAR}I don’t stick to just one type.

strings.zh: 小绿『和{VAR:0103:0}一起战斗,{NEWLINE}这感觉还真让人怀念。
strings.en: Blue: Battling alongside {VAR:0103:0}...{NEWLINE}This takes me back.

strings.zh: 小绿『好傻啊⋯⋯
strings.en: Blue: How dumb...

strings.zh: 小黄『你要用那个吗？{NEWLINE}小黄要变成孤零零一个人了呀。
strings.en: Yellow: You’re going to use that?{NEWLINE}Yellow will be left all alone...

strings.zh: 小黄『你要用那个吗？{NEWLINE}小黄要变成孤零零一个人了呀。
strings.en: Yellow: You’re going to use that?{NEWLINE}Yellow will be left all alone...

strings.zh: 小黄『不是那边啊,{NEWLINE}下去后会迷路的⋯⋯
strings.en: Yellow: Not that way.{NEWLINE}We’ll get lost down there...

strings.zh: 小黄『我非常喜欢像{NEWLINE}叫声,{CLEAR}变小这种{CLEAR}能够救精灵一条命{CLEAR}的技能
strings.en: Yellow: I really love moves{NEWLINE}like Growl{CLEAR}and Minimize...{CLEAR}moves that can save{CLEAR}a Pokémon’s life.

strings.zh: 小黄『这个洞窟⋯⋯{NEWLINE}会让人不知道{CLEAR}自己走在哪里啊⋯⋯
strings.en: Yellow: In this cave...{NEWLINE}you can’t tell{CLEAR}where you’re walking...

strings.zh: 小黄『{VAR:0103:0}是不是{NEWLINE}长久以来都和精灵在一起{CLEAR}所以变得这么强了？{SCROLL}一定是这样的吧！{NEWLINE}小黄也要加油！
strings.en: Yellow: {VAR:0103:0}, did you get{NEWLINE}so strong because you’ve been{CLEAR}with Pokémon for so long?{SCROLL}I bet that’s it!{NEWLINE}Yellow will do her best too!

strings.zh: 彦『要是用了那个{NEWLINE}我们就要在这里拜拜了啊。
strings.en: Riley: If you use that,{NEWLINE}we’ll have to say goodbye here.

strings.zh: 彦『要是用了那个技能,{NEWLINE}我们就要在这里道别了啊。
strings.en: Riley: If you use that move,{NEWLINE}we’ll have to say goodbye here.

strings.zh: 彦『哈哈,是啊。{NEWLINE}在这修行,{CLEAR}在某种意义上真是闲人啊。
strings.en: Riley: Ha ha, you’re right.{NEWLINE}Training out here,{CLEAR}I guess I’ve got time on my hands.

strings.zh: 彦『这里过去还是{NEWLINE}繁荣的矿山。{SCROLL}现在钢铁都被采完了,{NEWLINE}只有精灵了啊。
strings.en: Riley: This used to be{NEWLINE}a thriving mine.{SCROLL}Now the iron’s all mined out,{NEWLINE}and only Pokémon are left.

strings.zh: 彦『见到滕岩了吗？{NEWLINE}他是美央市的道馆馆主。{SCROLL}那个人也想让我{NEWLINE}成为道馆馆主,{CLEAR}不过有瓢太在⋯⋯
strings.en: Riley: Have you met Byron?{NEWLINE}He’s the Canalave City Gym Leader.{SCROLL}He wants me to become{NEWLINE}a Gym Leader too,{CLEAR}but there’s Roark, you know...

strings.zh: 彦『使用钢铁精灵的{NEWLINE}精灵训练师{CLEAR}和钢铁精灵战斗,{SCROLL}感觉就像和自己战斗一样。{NEWLINE}是啊,比起战胜他人,{CLEAR}战胜自己更加困难啊。
strings.en: Riley: When a Trainer who uses{NEWLINE}Steel-type Pokémon{CLEAR}battles Steel-type Pokémon,{SCROLL}it’s like battling yourself. Yes...{NEWLINE}Beating yourself is harder{CLEAR}than beating anyone else.

strings.zh: 彦『精灵为什么会{NEWLINE}这么慌张呢？{SCROLL}真担心⋯⋯{NEWLINE}我们还是快走吧。
strings.en: Riley: Why are the Pokémon{NEWLINE}so agitated?{SCROLL}It worries me...{NEWLINE}Let’s hurry.

strings.zh: 彦『谢谢你救了我。{NEWLINE}请收下这个精灵⋯⋯{CLEAR}它叫路卡,{CLEAR}你能带它走吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Riley: Thank you for saving me.{NEWLINE}Please accept this Pokémon...{CLEAR}Its name is Luca.{CLEAR}Would you take it with you?{SCROLL}
strings.notes: 路卡 = JP ルカ, the name Riley gives his Pokémon (Riolu/Lucario); kept as 'Luca'. Unverified. | RV058: meaning: 请收下 = please accept

strings.zh: 彦『谢谢！{SCROLL}希望你能让路卡{NEWLINE}看到更广阔的天地。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Riley: Thank you!{SCROLL}I hope you’ll show Luca{NEWLINE}how big the world is.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 彦『谢谢⋯⋯{SCROLL}不过看起来,{NEWLINE}你不能再接受精灵了啊,{SCROLL}好吧,{NEWLINE}我在这等你啊。
strings.en: Riley: Thank you...{SCROLL}But it looks like you can’t{NEWLINE}take any more Pokémon.{SCROLL}All right.{NEWLINE}I’ll wait for you here.

strings.zh: 彦『请一定收下。{NEWLINE}作为我们友情的证明。
strings.en: Riley: Please, take it.{NEWLINE}As proof of our friendship.

strings.zh: 彦『能和你在一起{NEWLINE}真是非常有趣。{SCROLL}我也想在很多地方,{NEWLINE}试试自己的能力。{SCROLL}希望能再见到你。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Riley: Traveling with you{NEWLINE}was a lot of fun.{SCROLL}I want to test my strength{NEWLINE}in all kinds of places, too.{SCROLL}I hope we meet again.{SCROLL}

strings.en: Marley: ...You’re leaving me behind?

strings.zh: 小霞『呜哇~{VAR:0103:0}！{NEWLINE}要用了那个,我和精灵{CLEAR}都要被抛下啊！别这样啊！
strings.en: Misty: Whoa, {VAR:0103:0}!{NEWLINE}If you use that, my Pokémon and I{CLEAR}will be left behind! Don’t do it!

strings.zh: 小霞『为什么执着于水系精灵？{NEWLINE}其实我也不知道这是为什么。{CLEAR}怎么说呢,{CLEAR}嗯~因为我已经下了决心了。
strings.en: Misty: Why am I so into Water types?{NEWLINE}Honestly, I don’t know myself.{CLEAR}How do I put it...{CLEAR}I just made up my mind, that’s all.

strings.zh: 小霞『并非我刻意要成为最强。{NEWLINE}但要是输了,{CLEAR}会觉得很对不起精灵。{CLEAR}因为它很努力,{CLEAR}作为训练家就要{CLEAR}去回报它的付出！
strings.en: Misty: It’s not that I have to be{NEWLINE}the strongest. But when I lose,{CLEAR}I feel like I’ve let my Pokémon down.{CLEAR}They try so hard for me,{CLEAR}and as their Trainer,{CLEAR}I have to repay them!

strings.zh: 小霞『以前可能有人会想,{NEWLINE}我是靠着父亲{CLEAR}才能执掌华蓝道馆。{CLEAR}但我最终依靠自己的力量{CLEAR}通过了馆主考核！
strings.en: Misty: Some people used to think{NEWLINE}I only got to run Cerulean Gym{CLEAR}because of my dad.{CLEAR}But I passed the Gym Leader{CLEAR}assessment on my own!

strings.zh: 小霞『成为道馆馆主之后{NEWLINE}要考虑方方面面的事,{CLEAR}这个工作还真是相当累人！
strings.en: Misty: Once you’re a Gym Leader,{NEWLINE}you have to think about everything.{CLEAR}It’s a seriously tiring job!
